en_title: Rockstar Games Staff Set for 'Historic' Union Vote at the Same Time GTA 6 Comes Out
subtitle: 两次创造历史的机会
opus_summary: Rockstar员工将于11月12日至26日投票决定是否认可工会，恰逢《GTA6》发售。若投票通过，该工会将成为英国游戏业获正式认可的最大工会。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar staff will vote on union recognition amid the launch of GTA 6 .
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar员工将在《GTA6》发售期间，投票决定是否认可工会。

paragraphs.en: Recognition of the IWGB Union at Rockstar will be put to an employee vote from November 12-26, which just so happens to coincide with the release of GTA 6 itself, on November 19.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar员工将于11月12日至26日投票，决定是否认可IWGB工会，而《GTA6》恰好将在这期间的11月19日发售。

paragraphs.en: The terms of the recognition deal were agreed following months of negotiations that took place even as the IWGB and Rockstar clashed over the firing of 31 workers for allegedly leaking company secrets in October last year. The IWGB has alleged the workers were unlawfully fired, and have accused Rockstar Games of union busting. The vote will overlap with the closing submissions of the ongoing employment tribunal, which are set for November 17-18.
paragraphs.cn: 双方经过数月谈判，就工会认可协议的条款达成一致。谈判期间，IWGB与Rockstar仍在就去年10月31名员工因涉嫌泄露公司机密遭解雇一事发生争执。IWGB称，这些员工遭到违法解雇，并指控Rockstar打压工会。相关劳动法庭程序仍在进行，定于11月17日至18日提交结案陈词，也在此次投票期间。

paragraphs.en: The deal would give workers a say over topics including pay and bonuses, overtime, redundancies, flexible working arrangements, and generative AI policies, the IWGB said. Developer Rockstar North, which is part of GTA publisher Rockstar Games, is in Edinburgh, Scotland. If the IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union wins the vote, it will become the biggest recognised union in the UK games industry, and, officials said, could boost unionisation efforts across the rest of the industry.
paragraphs.cn: IWGB表示，这份协议将让员工在薪酬与奖金、加班、裁员、弹性工作安排及生成式AI政策等议题上拥有发言权。开发商Rockstar North位于苏格兰爱丁堡，隶属于《GTA》发行商Rockstar。如果IWGB旗下的Rockstar游戏员工工会赢得投票，它将成为英国游戏业获正式认可的最大工会。工会官员表示，这也可能推动业内其他公司的员工组建工会。

paragraphs.en: Throughout the process, Rockstar has indicated its willingness to work with staff on union recognition. Rockstar Head of Publishing Jennifer Kolbe recently told Bloomberg : “We go where the team goes. So if they want a union, they will have a union.”
paragraphs.cn: 在整个过程中，Rockstar一直表示愿意就工会认可事宜与员工合作。Rockstar发行负责人Jennifer Kolbe近日向彭博社表示：「我们尊重团队的选择。所以，如果他们想要工会，就会有工会。」

paragraphs.en: Rockstar North production co-ordinator and Rockstar Game Workers Union Committee Member Shanti Easton-Steel commented: “This November, we have the chance to make gaming history not once but twice. As all our hard work, skill and creativity are experienced by GTA 6 players for the first time, our voices will now be heard for the first time too.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar North制作协调员、Rockstar游戏员工工会委员会成员Shanti Easton-Steel表示：「今年11月，我们有机会两次创造游戏历史，而不只是一次。当《GTA6》玩家首次体验到我们所有辛勤付出、技艺与创意的成果时，我们的声音也将首次得到倾听。」

paragraphs.en: “For me, this vote comes down to ensuring employees at Rockstar get honesty and openness surrounding the decisions that affect them. When management choices are kept hidden, we can’t properly address issues like the gender pay gap, the uneven and ever-changing policies on overtime pay, or the concerns many co-workers hold around job security post-release.
paragraphs.cn: 「对我来说，这次投票归根结底是要确保Rockstar在作出影响员工的决策时，能够坦诚、公开地向员工说明。如果管理层的决定不对员工公开，我们就无法妥善解决性别薪酬差距、不统一且不断变化的加班费政策等问题，也无法妥善回应许多同事对游戏发售后工作保障的担忧。」

paragraphs.en: “This is our moment to secure a window onto the decisions that shape our lives, and a seat at the table to improve them. I’m immensely proud of the games Rockstar gives its fans — I want to be equally proud of the voice Rockstar gives its staff.”
paragraphs.cn: 「现在，我们有机会了解那些影响我们生活的决策，并参与其中，让这些决策变得更好。我为Rockstar带给粉丝的游戏无比自豪——我希望，Rockstar给予员工的发言权也能让我同样自豪。」

paragraphs.en: Alex Marshall, President of the IWGB Union, called the vote “just as historic as the game release.”
paragraphs.cn: IWGB工会主席Alex Marshall称，这次投票「与游戏发售同样具有历史意义」。

paragraphs.en: “But for workers at Rockstar, it is so much more personal: it is fundamentally a choice about whether you get to have a say in how your day-to-day life is organised,” he continued.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「但对Rockstar的员工来说，这件事更关乎切身利益：从根本上说，这个选择决定了你能否对自己的日常生活安排拥有发言权。」

paragraphs.en: “From pay and pensions to parental leave and overtime, this agreement is a real chance to be involved in decision-making at Rockstar by becoming part of a democratic and member-led union.”
paragraphs.cn: 「从薪酬、养老金到育儿假和加班，这份协议给了员工一个真正的机会：加入一个民主、由会员主导的工会，参与Rockstar的决策。」
